title: Max Subarray Under Assign
prompt:
**Bài toán.** `1 l r v` assigns v to [l, r]; `2 l r` prints the maximum
non-empty subarray sum inside [l, r].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2·10^5; |v|, |a[i]| ≤ 10^9.

tests.name: cross the boundary
tests.hint: [5,-10,6]: best non-empty is 6. After assign [5,100,6]: whole array 111 — the cross term (ss+pp across the middle) is required.

tests.name: assign fixes middle
n=200000 alt load
tests.hint: Alternating ±1: every whole-array query answers 1; Kadane-per-query is 4·10^10 ops — certain TLE.
